Local Effect: Safety switch does not actuate on demand
System Effect: Safety function fails dangerously — hazard not detected
Recommended Action: Immediate proof-test; replace if failed; review SIL maintenance schedule

System Effect: Nuisance shutdown
Detection Method: Trip log review; instrument calibration check
Recommended Action: Re-calibrate set-point; check for vibration or contamination

System Effect: Pressure control acts to vent — loss of containment risk
Detection Method: Cross-check with PI; PSV set-point reference
Recommended Action: Check for blocked tap or condensate pot; recalibrate

System Effect: Pressure builds undetected — overpressure hazard
Detection Method: PSV / rupture disc as independent layer
Recommended Action: Inspect impulse line blockage; replace transmitter

System Effect: Uncontrolled flow — possible flooding or overpressure downstream
Recommended Action: Switch to manual bypass; inspect actuator diaphragm, positioner

System Effect: Flow stoppage — process starvation, pump dead-heading
Detection Method: Low flow alarm (FIA-L); pump trip on low-flow protection
Recommended Action: Check air supply pressure; inspect positioner; replace actuator

System Effect: Loss of control — process drifts from setpoint
Recommended Action: Check valve positioner signal; inspect packing / gland

System Effect: Fugitive emission — HSE hazard if toxic/flammable
Detection Method: Periodic leak check per API 624; FID / gas detector
Recommended Action: Tighten packing; replace stem packing at next shutdown
